set.body: Slice of Ledger S2 (bd-01M3FA6GY2YX7098MRYVKSR9ZK). A Stepwise cursor in io, in order: preflight sizes; source digest vs ledger.source; per row, scalar preflight, parseRow, then compare with ledger.records(i) and outsideFrame; counted merge sort over (key, ordinal); trialRefusal; then admitted trials compared fixation by fixation against input.trials.rows(j) without rebuilding Scanpaths. It keeps the first mismatch per component, emits errors in S1's precedence order, and ends in VerifiedAdmission. Charge policy.correctionFor per rule.
set.title: Ledger S2.3: replay cursor on the validated-input route
